tasks.title: Calculate the total daily capacities of public land transports
tasks.statement:
Calculate the total daily capacities of public land transports (bus and light bus) using the following assumed values (you must show your work).

Assumptions:
- Passenger capacity – Bus: 150; Light bus: 16
- Number of trips per bus route per day – Weekday: 50; Weekend & holidays: 65
- Number of trips per Light bus route per day – Weekday: 60; Weekend: 90

parts.question: Calculate the total daily capacities of public land transports (bus and light bus) and fill in the table for weekday and weekend & holidays.

tasks.title: Development plan for Sai Kung Town
tasks.statement: The government plans to further develop Sai Kung Town to build upon its existing functions. The new development can take place on converted or new land of up to 1 hectare (10,000 m2).

parts.question: On Figure C2 below, mark the area(s) that you suggest to be developed. Annotate the map to give a rationale for your choice.

Write a development plan for Sai Kung Town. Through making references to Figure C2, explain on the next page how your proposed plan will build on the existing functions of the town, and at the same time alleviate issues identified in question 5. Take account of the (i) benefits for local residents and visitors, as well as (ii) environmental considerations.
